html:
SMTO-UI-0030 — This link points to a setting that isn't available

GUID: 58f9e1ba-a633-454e-a510-554627e9370d
Slug: ui-setting-target-missing
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • You opened Settings from a link that should jump to one setting, but that setting isn't on this page in this version of SMTO. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select the magnifying glass (Search this surface) at the top of the Settings page and type a word from the setting you need. The link couldn't find the setting, but it may still exist under a different name or group.
  2. Look through the setting groups in the Settings menu: General, Setup, Agent behavior, Operate, Security and Data. Settings are sorted into these groups, so the one you need is likely in the group that matches its topic.
  3. If you came here from an error message, reload the page that showed that error, then follow its link again. A page opened before an SMTO update can hold a link to a setting that has since moved.

What success looks like

  • You find the setting you were looking for and can change it on the Settings page.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details, and copy the page address too, then send both to the person who manages SMTO. The link itself may need fixing.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Settings deep link's section/setting/parameter/action query does not match exactly one control in the current server settings registry (unknown section, unknown key, or more than one target in the link).

What this means

  • A settings link has no matching registry section/control or combines more than one setting, parameter or action target. This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.

Why this can happen

  • A settings link has no matching registry section/control or combines more than one setting, parameter or action target.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect its section and target fields against the current registry.

How to fix it

  • settings.js focusErrorSetting() presents ui_setting_target_missing when the ?section= value has no registry section, ?setting=/?parameter=/?action= is not in that section, or more than one of them is supplied. Compare the link with the current registry from the Settings API; if a catalog entry links to a renamed or removed setting, update that entry's settings link.
  • Search the current settings page for the intended control. Preserve the error link if its catalog and installed settings no longer agree.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The link selects exactly one supported settings destination.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
